criterion: The approved quality evaluation must achieve at least 90 percent and match the deployed prompt p7.
explanation: The requirement mandates answer quality evaluation must achieve ≥90% accuracy AND match the deployed prompt p7 in production. REC-4323's evaluation (EVAL-55) achieved 96.2% accuracy in production but used prompt bundle p6 (frozen 2026-11-01), conflicting with the target prompt p7. This violates the dual criteria. REQ-03's developer marked it Done without verifying prompt alignment, further confirming failure. No other evidence shows production evaluation with prompt p7.
